heldPriceScenario.result: Trade-moved price eventually enters the TWAP and is accepted. This demonstrates a limitation, not manipulation safety.

limitations: Exploratory settings are not approved production parameters
This suite tests upward swaps; downward-gap engine/exit timing is recorded separately in isolated-oracle-gap-observations.json
WETH inputs are trade sizes, not attack costs or net losses; purchased tokens remain with the trader
No arbitrage, MEV, sequencer outage, flash financing or concurrent liquidation model
Two windows on these same pools are correlated and do not meet the engine's independent-pricing requirement
Liquidity minimums use raw concentrated-liquidity units, not executable USDG sale depth
Timestamp measures actual oracle writes, not necessarily economic price discovery; same-tick swaps may not refresh it
